findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) On arrival, the 3 part sink in the kitchen was observed using a Quat based sanitizer. The only test strips available for checking the concentration of sanitizers are intended for Chlorine based sanitizers. PIC is instructed to ensure that the test strips used in the facility are intended for use on the sanitizer being used. The sink was remade with bleach during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

Observed the blade of the can opener in the kitchen to be heavily soiled. Discussed with the PIC and the item was moved to the washing and was cleaned during the inspection.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment:
750-530a Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.

Employee drinks (a 2 liter of fanta, a gallon container of orange Gatorade and a 16 oz bottle of mountain dew code red) were observed on the counters and in the refrigerator along side foods intended for the consumers. Discussed with the PIC and the items were moved to the employee lounge during the inspection.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

The test strips in the facility are used for testing CL based sanitizers while the facility uses Quat based sanitizers. Test strips sould be used that check the concentrations of chemicals being used. Discussed with the PIC and instructed to use test strips designed for the chemical being used.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

On arrival, the sanitizer in the 3 compartment sink was observed to be at 0 parts per million (ppm) sanitizer. Discussed with the PIC and the water was adjusted to 200 ppm Quat during the inspection.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.
Observed a moist rag stored on the counter. Rag was stated to be used for sanitizing surfaces. Wet rags should be stored in sanitizers between uses to prevent the growth of pathogens. A bucket was produced during the inspection for the rag.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory. Observed several hand sinks without paper towels. Instructed the cook to have some on hand in the kitchen and discussed the rest with the Person in Charge.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: 750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control. Observed several fruit flies in the storage area. It is believed that they were the result of a box of sweet potatoes that had gone bad. The potatoes were discarded and the flies should be taken care of.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed single service cups stored on the ground. The cups must be at least 6" off the floor.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no hand soap in the women's restroom. Replace the handwashing soap.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Observed utensils stored incorrectly. The utensils were stored in a manner to protect them from cross contamination.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed bulk powders that had no label.  The powders were labeled with the proper common name during the inspection.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels and hand soap at the men's restroom sink.  Place soap and paper towels in the restroom. (IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED)
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the coving coming apart from the wall in the men's restroom next to the sink.  Re seal the coving to the wall.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
